tool_args.rationale: The short-window positive gain is consistent with the archived endogenous dual-horizon adaptation mechanism, but cannot determine its slow component or predict the reversal near H=23. Acquire the slow-horizon discriminating probe before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit dual-horizon endogenous adaptation from initial rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All five measurements use short horizons (0.16–0.48), so the slow reversal and long-time behavior are not identifiable for the target horizon H=23.

This is intended for coupled memory ODE identification; the pilot signature and archive point instead to dual-horizon reversal, whose ambiguity is resolved more directly by a slow-horizon observation.
Nuisance auxiliary data are explicitly irrelevant and should not be purchased.
